jobs.description:
McKesson, l’une des 10 premières entreprises du classement Fortune Global 500, touche à pratiquement tous les aspects des soins de santé et s’emploie à faire une réelle différence. Nous sommes reconnus pour notre capacité à offrir un savoir, des produits et des services qui rendent les soins de qualité plus accessibles et plus abordables. Chez nous, la santé, le bonheur et le bien-être de nos gens et des personnes que nous desservons sont prioritaires—et nous tiennent à cœur.

Ce que tu fais chez McKesson a de l’importance. Nous favorisons une culture où tu peux t’épanouir et avoir un impact, et où tu es encouragé à proposer de nouvelles idées. Ensemble, nous façonnons l’avenir de la santé pour nos patients, nos communautés et nos équipes. Si tu souhaites dès aujourd’hui contribuer à la santé de demain, nous aimerions avoir de tes nouvelles.

McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

English Description Follows

Modalités de travail :
Il s’agit d’un poste hybride qui exige que les candidat(e)s travaillent sur place au moins 2 jours par semaine dans notre bureau de Montréal. Les autres jours peuvent être travaillés à distance, selon les besoins de l’équipe et de l’unité d’affaire.

À propos du poste (sommaire) :

Le ou la Directeur(trice) principal(e), Opérations du marketing numérique est responsable de définir et de mettre en œuvre la stratégie organisationnelle liée aux plateformes numériques et aux technologies marketing. Cette personne dirige les produits numériques, les plateformes marketing, les processus opérationnels et des équipes multidisciplinaires afin d’offrir des expériences numériques performantes, évolutives et alignées sur les objectifs de croissance de l’entreprise et d’engagement de la clientèle.

Ce rôle combine le leadership stratégique, la gestion de produits numériques, l’expertise en technologies marketing (MarTech), l’excellence opérationnelle et la prise de décision fondée sur les données. La personne retenue collaborera étroitement avec les équipes Marketing, Technologies, Produits numériques et les leaders d’affaires afin d’optimiser les plateformes, d’améliorer l’efficacité opérationnelle et de faire progresser les initiatives de transformation numérique.

Ce que vous ferez (responsabilités) :

Stratégie numérique et leadership :

Élaborer et mettre en œuvre une stratégie pluriannuelle liée aux plateformes numériques et aux technologies marketing, en cohérence avec les objectifs organisationnels et commerciaux.
Établir les priorités stratégiques, les normes opérationnelles, les indicateurs de performance et les cadres de gouvernance pour les opérations de marketing numérique.
Diriger et développer des équipes hautement performantes en favorisant la collaboration, l’innovation et l’amélioration continue.

Gestion des produits et des plateformes numériques :

Assurer la responsabilité de la feuille de route et de la gestion du cycle de vie des produits numériques, notamment les sites Web, les applications mobiles et les autres plateformes soutenant les activités marketing.
Collaborer avec les équipes Technologies et Produits numériques afin de prioriser les améliorations, garantir la fiabilité des plateformes et offrir une expérience utilisateur exceptionnelle.
Représenter les exigences des parties prenantes d’affaires tout au long des activités de planification, de développement, d’essais et de déploiement.

Technologies marketing et opérations :

Superviser la sélection, l’implantation, l’intégration et l’optimisation des solutions de technologies marketing, notamment les plateformes de gestion de la relation client (CRM), les outils d’automatisation marketing, les systèmes de gestion de contenu et les plateformes analytiques.
Mettre en place des processus opérationnels et des mécanismes de gouvernance afin d’assurer un déploiement efficace du contenu marketing sur les canaux numériques de l’organisation.
Favoriser l’excellence opérationnelle grâce à des initiatives d’amélioration des processus et à l’identification d’occasions d’automatisation.

Analyse et optimisation de la performance :

Évaluer les indicateurs de performance, les données sur la clientèle et les analyses numériques afin de mesurer l’efficacité des initiatives et de cibler les occasions d’amélioration.
Transformer les données en recommandations concrètes permettant d’améliorer l’expérience client, l’efficacité opérationnelle et les résultats d’affaires.
Effectuer une veille des tendances du secteur, des technologies émergentes et des meilleures pratiques numériques afin de maintenir un avantage concurrentiel.

Gestion des fournisseurs et des parties prenantes :

Établir et entretenir de solides partenariats avec les parties prenantes internes, la haute direction et les fournisseurs externes.
Gérer les relations avec les fournisseurs, les négociations contractuelles, les ententes de niveau de service et la performance liée à la livraison des solutions.
Influencer les décisions à l’échelle de l’organisation relativement aux capacités numériques, aux investissements technologiques et aux priorités opérationnelles.

Exigences de base :

Baccalauréat en marketing, en administration des affaires, en technologies de l’information ou dans un domaine connexe.
Plus de 10 ans d’expérience progressive en marketing numérique, en opérations marketing, en technologies marketing, en gestion de produits numériques ou dans un domaine connexe.
Plus de 5 ans d’expérience en gestion d’équipes, incluant la supervision de gestionnaires et d’équipes multidisciplinaires.
Capacité à analyser les données et les tendances du marché afin d’éclairer les décisions stratégiques.
Expérience dans l’élaboration et l’exécution de stratégies liées aux plateformes numériques, aux technologies marketing ou à la transformation numérique.
Expérience dans la gestion de sites Web, d’applications mobiles, de plateformes numériques ou de solutions technologiques marketing d’envergure organisationnelle.
Expérience avec les plateformes CRM, les outils d’automatisation marketing, les systèmes de gestion de contenu et les solutions d’analytique numérique.
Expérience en gestion budgétaire et en optimisation du rendement du capital investi (RCI).
Excellentes aptitudes en leadership, en communication et en collaboration.

Compétences et expérience privilégiées :

Maîtrise en marketing, en administration des affaires, en technologies de l’information ou dans un domaine connexe.
Expérience dans les secteurs des soins de santé, du commerce de détail, de la distribution ou dans d’autres industries fortement réglementées.
Le bilinguisme (français et anglais) est considéré comme un atout.

Le/la titulaire de ce poste aura à soutenir de façon quotidienne des clients internes et/ou externes à l’extérieur du Québec et/ou aux États-Unis. Par conséquent, ce poste requiert une maîtrise de l’anglais à l’écrit et à l’oral. Veuillez noter que le nombre de postes dont les tâches requièrent une connaissance de la langue anglaise a été restreint dans la mesure du possible.

Work Arrangement:
This is a hybrid position requiring candidates to work on-site at least 2 days per week at our office in Montreal. The remaining days may be worked remotely, subject to team and business needs.

About the Role (Job Summary):

The Sr. Director, Digital Marketing Operations is responsible for shaping and executing the organization's digital platform and marketing technology strategy. This leader oversees digital products, marketing platforms, operational processes, and cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, high-performing digital experiences that support business growth and customer engagement.

This role combines strategic leadership, digital product management, marketing technology (MarTech) expertise, operational excellence, and data-driven decision-making. The successful candidate will partner closely with Marketing, Technology, Digital Product, and Business leaders to optimize platforms, improve operational effectiveness, and advance digital transformation initiatives.

What You'll Do (Responsibilities):

Digital Strategy & Leadership:

Develop and execute a multi-year digital platform and marketing technology strategy aligned with organizational and commercial objectives.
Establish strategic priorities, operational standards, performance metrics, and governance frameworks for digital marketing operations.
Lead and develop high-performing teams, fostering collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Digital Product & Platform Management:

Own the roadmap and lifecycle management of digital products, including websites, mobile applications, and other marketing-enabled platforms.
Partner with Technology and Digital Product teams to prioritize enhancements, ensure platform reliability, and deliver exceptional user experiences.
Represent business stakeholder requirements throughout planning, development, testing, and deployment activities.

Marketing Technology & Operations:

Oversee the selection, implementation, integration, and optimization of marketing technology solutions, including CRM platforms, marketing automation tools, content management systems, and analytics platforms.
Establish operational processes and governance to support the efficient deployment of marketing content across owned digital channels.
Drive operational excellence through process improvement initiatives and automation opportunities.

Analytics & Performance Optimization:

Evaluate performance metrics, customer insights, and digital analytics to measure effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.
Translate data into actionable recommendations that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.
Monitor industry trends, emerging technologies, and evolving digital best practices to maintain a competitive advantage.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management:

Build strong partnerships with internal stakeholders, senior leadership, and external vendors.
Manage vendor relationships, contract negotiations, service-level agreements, and solution delivery performance.
Influence enterprise-wide decisions related to digital capabilities, technology investments, and operational priorities.

Basic Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field.
10+ years of progressive experience in digital marketing, marketing operations, marketing technology, digital product management, or related disciplines.
5+ years of people leadership experience, including leadership of managers and cross-functional teams.
Ability to analyze data and market trends to inform strategic decisions.
Experience developing and executing digital platform, marketing technology, or digital transformation strategies.
Experience managing websites, mobile applications, digital platforms, or enterprise marketing technology solutions.
Experience working with CRM platforms, marketing automation tools, content management systems, and digital analytics solutions.
Experience managing budgets and optimizing ROI.
Excellent leadership, communication, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Skills & Experience:

Master's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field.
Experience in healthcare, retail, distribution, or other highly regulated industries.
Bilingualism (English and French) is considered an asset.

jobs.title: Director of Strategic Finance
jobs.description:
About Forma.ai:
  Forma.ai is a Series B startup that's revolutionizing how sales compensation is designed, managed and optimized. We handle billions in annual managed commissions for market leaders like Edmentum, Stryker, and Autodesk. 
Our growth has been fuelled by our passion for fundamentally changing and shaping how companies use sales intelligence to drive business strategy.  
We’re welcoming equally driven individuals who are excited about creating something big!  
DIRECTOR OF STRATEGIC FINANCE

Strategic FP&A, AI Automation, & Executive-Level Storytelling
ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are looking for an exceptional, hands-on Director of Strategic Finance to act as the strategic right-hand lead to our VP of Finance. Operating alongside our Controller (who leads accounting close, statutory compliance, tax, and ERP administration), you will own our forward-looking financial strategy. You will lead our corporate modelling, deploy AI and modern automation workflows across Finance and RevOps, execute on M&A and capital markets transactions, and use generative AI or AI applications to build out high-performance analytics frameworks as the company scales.
WHAT YOU'LL DO (KEY RESPONSIBILITIES):

1. Hands-On Strategic FP&A & Corporate Modeling
• Corporate Financial Architecture: Build and maintain our dynamic 3-statement models, weekly/monthly/quarterly operating plans, revenue forecasting, multi-year operating forecasts, and scenario analyses from the ground up without relying on junior analysts.
• Executive & Board Presentation: Spearhead the quantitative financial narrative, analysis, and materials for Board of Directors meetings, executive quarterly reviews, and investor reporting.
• Corporate Planning: Lead the annual budgeting process by working with the executive team to develop an annual plan with near real-time reporting on plan progress.
• Future Team Foundation: Establish rigorous modeling standards and analytical infrastructure today, with the mandate to hire, mentor, and build out an FP&A and FinOps team over the next 1–2 years.
2. Financial Engineering & AI Workflow Automation
• AI Agent & Workflow Deployment: Identify manual bottlenecks across billing, contract parsing, data extraction, and commercial operations; build and deploy LLM workflows, custom prompts, and automated scripts.
• Data Pipeline & Systems Integration: Architect and optimize data flows connecting CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot), CPQ, Billing, and ERP systems to automate revenue operations and eliminate reconciliation friction.
• Modern Automation Tooling: Use tools like Python, SQL, Zapier/Make, and API integrations to establish self-sustaining, real-time reporting layers.
• AI Analytics & Insights: Leverage AI to drive deeper analysis and insights throughout the organization (i.e. QBR’s, MMR’s, BvA’s)
3. RevOps & Commercial Structuring
• GTM Engine Analytics: Partner with RevOps to track and analyze sales capacity, pipeline velocity, CAC/LTV dynamics, and retention cohorts.
• Deal Structuring & Deal Desk: Serve as the primary strategic finance partner to Sales and RevOps on deal structuring, pricing models, margin analysis, discounting schedules, and commercial contract terms.
4. M&A / Capital Markets Execution & Compensation Modelling

• Transaction & Valuation Execution: Own the operational execution for M&A / capital market transactions, including due diligence financial modelling, virtual data room (VDR) setup, and cap table administration
• Compensation Architecture: Model and maintain corporate compensation bands, incentive structures, and equity option pool dilution economics.

WHO YOU ARE (QUALIFICATIONS):

- 7–10+ years in Strategic Finance, FP&A, BizOps, or Investment Banking / Management Consulting followed by high-growth B2B SaaS operational experience. Strong business acumen with a high intellectual curiosity.
- FP&A Mastery:
Spreadsheet wizard with demonstrated mastery of complex revenue modelling, 3-statement modelling, operational modelling, SaaS metrics (ARR, NRR, GRR, CAC payback), and executive-level financial storytelling.
- Engineering & AI Mindset:
Practical experience architecting the finance tech stack and working with data, deploying AI/LLM tools, automation platforms (Python, SQL, Zapier/Make), and SaaS toolchains (Salesforce, Stripe/Chargebee, NetSuite) to eliminate manual workflows.
- Commercial Depth:
Proven deal desk and commercial contract experience, with a solid grasp of pricing models, billing schedules, and equity compensation economics.
- Autonomy & Drive:
High-autonomy builder who thrives with ambiguity and enjoys executing hands-on work from scratch with the leadership aptitude to manage direct reports as the team grows.

WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT:

You won't be managing month-end reconciliations, audits, tax filings, or HR administration—our Controller leads those domains with excellence. You are joining to be an operational architect and strategic partner: designing intelligent financial infrastructure, building board-level models, and leveraging AI to scale our operational engine.

ADDITIONAL JOB INFO:

This position is for an existing vacancy
Salary range: 150-180K

What you can expect from us Meaningful compensation.
In addition to your base salary, you’ll join our employee stock ownership plan to further recognize your contributions to Forma.ai’s success.
Healthcare coverage.
We have a full benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance, and a paid parental leave program.
Learning and development.
Access the resources you want to help you grow in your role by utilizing our $750 yearly training stipend.
Growth.
You’ll have a huge opportunity to build a career for yourself and gain the type of experience you’re looking for, whether that’s as an individual contributor or as a people leader.
Our Values:
  Work well, together.
We’re real. We have kids and pets. Mortgages and student loans. We’re in this together, so no matter how brilliant any one of us is, we always play nice with one another – no exceptions.  
Be precise. Be relentless.
We believe complacency breeds failure, so we set new goals as quickly as we achieve them. We persist in the face of adversity, learn from our mistakes, and push each other to continuously improve. The status-quo is kryptonite.
Love our tech. Love our customers.
Our platform solves a very complex problem in a currently underserved market. While everyone at Forma isn’t customer-facing, we’re all customer-focused. Maybe even slightly customer-obsessed. ­  

Use of AI for Recruitment
Currently, Forma.ai does not use artificial intelligence as part of our recruitment process, specifically but not limited to the screening, filtering and shortlisting of applicants.  
Our commitment to you:
  Forma is a proud equal opportunity employer that is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment.   Every effort to accommodate candidates for accessibility will be made upon request. Information received related to accommodations will be addressed confidentially. We know that applying to a new role takes a lot of effort. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. There are many paths to a successful career and we’re looking forward to reading yours.
We thank all candidates for their interest however only qualified applicants will be shortlisted.

jobs.description:
Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact.

At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses.

We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart
: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive.

So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.

The Adventure Ahead 🚀

As our Vice President, Information Security, you will step up as the de facto security leader owning Docebo’s global security strategy across product, cloud, GRC, and AI. This is not an advisory tower role; you will operate at executive altitude while staying close to real architecture, engineering decisions, threat modeling, and control execution. You will drive hard, measurable risk reduction while pioneering AI-first security practices that empower our business to move fast with complete confidence.

The Day-to-Day 🗓️

Architect Global Strategy: Own and evolve Docebo’s enterprise security roadmap across product security, cloud hardening, GRC, privacy, and incident response to achieve measurable control maturity.
Embed Security by Design: Partner deeply with Product and Engineering to integrate threat modeling, secure SDLC, CI/CD security, identity controls, and vulnerability remediation into core engineering workflows.
Pioneer AI-First Security: Build robust governance and controls for AI products and internal tooling while harnessing AI to automate detection, vulnerability management, and threat response.
Champion Customer Trust: Lead compliance programs (SOC 2, ISO 27001) backed by real controls, and represent Docebo with executive credibility in board updates, audits, and enterprise customer due diligence.
Elevate Defense Operations: Strengthen security telemetry, threat intelligence, and detection across cloud and corporate environments to protect against emerging modern attack patterns.
Empower High-Impact Teams: Lead and coach a talented security team, building a high-accountability culture focused on clear outcomes, rapid execution, and continuous learning.

Your Superpowers ⚡

Proven Executive Leadership: Significant experience leading information security programs in a software, SaaS, or tech product environment with a track record of executive and board collaboration.
Deep Technical Foundations: Hands-on mastery of application security, cloud security (AWS), infrastructure, identity systems, secure SDLC, and modern vulnerability management.
Mandatory Certification: Active CISSP credential backed by a deep understanding of SOC 2, ISO 27001, privacy regulations, and enterprise SaaS security standards.
Collaborative Business Driver: Exceptional ability to forge trusted partnerships across Product, Engineering, Legal, and Sales, acting as an enabler who balances security with business velocity.
Outcome-Focused Execution: A clear track record of using metrics and business risk language to make decisive, risk-informed choices in complex, ambiguous environments.

Bonus Points 🎯

AI Security Expertise: Hands-on experience securing AI-enabled products and LLMs, or utilizing AI tools to scale security operations and automated testing.
Advanced Technical Certifications: Additional credentials such as CISM, CISA, CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, or GIAC, combined with offensive security or red teaming experience.
Enterprise & Public Sector Reach: Proven experience navigating FedRAMP standards, public-sector requirements, and high-growth global SaaS expansion.

Our Hybrid Work Philosophy 🤝

Great work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy
🎉

Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People:

Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success.
Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being.
Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul.

Our Promise to You
😍

Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package.
Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it.
Rest, Relax, Repeat: Rest and recharge with paid vacation days, two company-wide Docebo Days, floating holidays for cultural celebrations, and your birthday off!
Family First: We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025!
Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long.

About Docebo 💙

At Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. We have successfully achieved two IPOs (TSX: DCBO & NASDAQ: DCBO), been recognized as a top SaaS e-learning solution, and are growing exponentially in the process. We're a global company, with office across North America, EMEA, APAC, and beyond. Our team is guided by five core values— Grow Together Win Together, Build with Our Customer, Clear is Kind, Own Outcomes, Progress Over Perfection
—that shape everything we do. If this resonates with you, now is the perfect time to join one of the fastest-growing learning technology companies in the world.

We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What You'll Be Doing

Our AI team builds enterprise capabilities that support a wide range of users across the organization, from end users to technology teams and low-code or no-code builders. As a Principal Product Scaler – AI Engineering, you'll build the engineering foundation that helps us repeatedly deliver high-quality AI products safely, efficiently, and at scale. You'll architect and develop the reusable components, software development kits, testing frameworks, and delivery patterns that move us from individual implementations to a mature product engineering model. You'll establish the standards for how AI products are designed, built, tested, packaged, released, and monitored in production. Working closely with data scientists, engineers, and technology partners, you'll help turn strong prototypes into reliable enterprise products while strengthening the team's overall engineering capability.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (proportion of on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.

Establish engineering excellence - Define and implement standards for code structure, testing, code review, versioning, packaging, documentation, release management, and production readiness for AI and Generative AI products.
Advance AI quality and reliability - Create automated testing, evaluation, regression, monitoring, and observability patterns that support both traditional software quality and the unique behavior of probabilistic AI systems.

You're motivated by collective success. You influence engineers, data scientists, technology partners, and leaders through strong partnership, sound judgment, and a commitment to raising the capability of the broader organization.
You act like an owner. You naturally identify repeated patterns, remove friction from the development lifecycle, and build practical solutions that help teams deliver faster, more safely, and with greater consistency.

jobs.description:
Company Name: UnitiWall Corporation
Location: Mississauga, ON

Are you a Finance leader who sees beyond the numbers and understands how Finance can drive business performance?

Do you thrive on solving complex problems, challenging assumptions, and turning financial insight into decisions that move the business forward?

Do you enjoy partnering with operational teams, asking the right questions, and translating financial analysis into practical actions and measurable results?

The Director of Finance is the day-to-day leader and end-to-end owner of UnitiWall’s Accounting and FP&A functions. forecast challenge, executive and departmental reviews, complex accounting judgments, project margin and recovery analysis, cash-flow decisions, business cases, process redesign, and communication of required actions.

transactional accounting, month-end close, reconciliations, AP, AR, payroll and inventory accounting, supporting schedules, and financial-statement working papers.

forecast models, budget and forecast consolidation, project and departmental analysis, KPIs, dashboards, variance analysis, and recurring management reporting.

reviews and approves team output and steps into detailed work when an issue is complex, urgent, or not supported by a mature process.

Financial Reporting, Accounting & Controls

dentify margin changes early and partner with project leaders on prevention, mitigation, and recovery actions through resolution.
